There is no evidence of malicious intent, obfuscation, or unauthorized behavior. The modifications are minimal, focused, and clearly documented as a build compatibility fix. The patch does not introduce network operations, file system manipulations, or any code execution outside the normal scope of the hardened_malloc library. This is a typical, benign adaptation to compiler changes.

No dangerous commands, data exfiltration, or supply-chain attack vectors are present. The patch operates entirely within the expected source code of the package and serves a legitimate development purpose.
</details>
